messages:
Maya: dropped a small prototype for the trace viewer header polish — figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/trace-header-compact
Maya: goal: make correlation ids less noisy, fold stack traces by default, and introduce a single "Save capture" CTA (instead of multiple export buttons).
Theo: Will users expect formats? we still need JSON/HAR options somewhere.
Priya: agree with Theo. My suggestion: primary action = "Save capture" (quick download defaults to JSON), kebab menu -> "Download as HAR" and "Download full bundle (incl. KV)"
Vik: perf ops: bundling KV can be huge. we should surface an estimated size + throttle long jobs. also background generation with signed link is safer.
Maya: noted. mock includes a size estimate chip next to CTA: "~ 4.8 MB · 3,402 spans". chip updates when filters change.
Priya: copy thought: "Save capture" vs "Download trace" vs "Export". I lean toward "Save capture" for clarity in product, less technical.
Theo: fine with "Save capture" if tooltip clarifies: "Quick save (JSON). Use menu for HAR / full bundle."
Vik: ops-bot idea: add a small warning when KV included: "This bundle may include sensitive keys. Confirm export." That triggers permission check.
Maya: added permission modal flow in frame 4. It shows role: trace:export and confirmation checkbox.
a11y-bot: auto-check: contrast for the size-chip is 2.9:1 on 1938765448. Needs 4.5:1 if text < 18px.
Priya: thanks. make chip text bolder and darken bg. Also add aria-live="polite" for the size estimate so screen readers hear updates when filters change.
Theo: keyboard UX: ordering should be Search -> Filters -> CTA -> Kebab. Focus ring is important. Also ensure the kebab is reachable via Shift+Tab microflow.
Maya: adding focus order notes and aria-label examples to the prototype annotations: aria-label="Save capture for trace 0x3fa2"
Vik: build notes: signed url TTL = 600s, background job queued with job-id. endpoint returns {"job_id": "...", "estimated_size": "..."}. small change.
Priya: small UI nit: correlation id pill currently looks like a tag; propose collapsed pill -> show first 8 chars + ellipsis, hover reveals full id and copy button. keeps header tidy.
Theo: good. also option to "Pin correlation id" to expand if user wants persistent visibility.
Maya: added pin affordance in frame 6. Pin state persists in local storage.
Vik: telemetry: track events: trace_export_clicked, trace_export_menu, export_size_confirmed, export_permission_requested. helps product measure how often full bundle used.
Priya: also track span_count in the event payload.
Maya: micro-interaction: when export completes, show a toast with: "Capture ready — Download (link) · Copy link (c)". include keyboard shortcut hint: "Press D then C to download / copy"
Theo: small accessibility thing: toast should not auto-dismiss until focusable copy link visited or after 8s with polite announcement when it disappears. aria-live updates required.
Maya: decision summary inline: primary CTA = "Save capture" (defaults to JSON), kebab for formats incl. HAR / full bundle, show estimated size + span count, permission modal for sensitive exports, collapsed correlation id pills + pin option, aria-live for dynamic size updates, contrast fixes for size chip. Maya -> will update figma and add annotation checklist.
Priya: can I run a short usability session on Friday? I want to see if "Save capture" language resonates with support engineers.
Maya: yes, pinged in calendar. Thanks! :sparkles:
